units.source_text: K开始问我一些他一向不会谈论的事情。

en.t: K began asking me about things he ordinarily would never discuss.

units.source_text: 他问夫人和小姐去了市谷的什么人家，我说大概是小姐的姑妈家。

en.t: He asked whose house in Ichigaya the lady and the young lady had gone to, and I said it was probably the young lady's aunt's house.

units.source_text: 他又问那位姑妈是什么人，我告诉他，也是个军人的妻子。

en.t: He then asked what sort of person that aunt was, and I told him that she too was the wife of a military man.

units.source_text: 于是他又问，女人拜年大多是在正月十五之后，夫人她们怎么这么早就去了？

en.t: Then he asked why, since women's New Year visits were usually made after the fifteenth of the first month, the lady and her daughter had gone so early.

units.source_text: 我只好回答，我也不知道为什么。

en.t: I could only answer that I did not know why either.

units.source_text: 1.百人一首：从一百个著名和歌诗人的和歌中，每人选取一首编辑成的和歌集。

en.t: 1. Hyakunin Isshu: a collection of waka poems compiled by selecting one poem from each of one hundred famous waka poets.
